notes:
Whole-first: the S3 record’s own movement path (#0 → #5→0) staged in order; every scene binds the S3 record (essay path + sha256 above) by its exact movement heading (verified present in the bound bytes at freeze time) plus one material record from the frozen inventory. Scene ids derive from the S record’s movement headings. Presentation mappings (tint, ground, term row, layout) are declared craft. Not corpus-complete: full per-product depth (all inventoried records as scenes) is the following fan-out.

Enrichment 2026-10-06. Per-scene moves — #0 s3-m0-becoming: quiet emergence; one formation walks intention→form→resistance→gathering back (the record's own sentence), resistance tinted copper; 17s. #1 s3-m1-desire-actuality: gather (attract/implode — desire enters); the Processual lens walks its own six terms to satisfaction; dispersion LFO (desire breathes). #2 s3-m2-material-grammar: turn (vortex); the elements precipitate in the record's order, Salt arriving largest and brightest; 3D here — z is the material grammar's depth: Aether the open field nearest, Salt the precipitated form deepest; 16s. #3 s3-m3-gate-recognition: hold (guard repel — the Gate decides under a declared condition); candidate→Gate→Recognition walks the distinction the record calls load-bearing; 13s. #4 s3-m4-labour-power: turn; layout ring (labour's circuit); commission→implementation→review→use→consequence walks the ring. #5->0 s3-m5-changed-field: settle — circulation reversed, speed lowest; Project Canon→returned Ground→changed condition; the slowest speed LFO (the field becomes capable of another movement); 13s.

3D: s3-m2 only; no other scene stages fake space. Pointer profiles: stillness (0.06) → gather → vortex → guard → vortex → settle — emergence, desire's intake, the grammar's composition, the Gate's boundary, labour's reallocation, the changed field at rest. Automation: dispersion LFO #1, slow speed sine #5->0. Durations 17/14/16/13/14/13; transitions 2.4/1.6/2.0/1.6/2.0/1.2.

glyph_rationales.intention: #0: 'Something is wanted' — the wanting that opens transformation
glyph_rationales.form: #0: 'a form is attempted' — the projected possibility
glyph_rationales.resistance: #0: 'actuality resists or confirms it' — the encounter's answer
glyph_rationales.gathering back: #0: 'what happened is gathered back into the conditions of what can happen next'
glyph_rationales.desire: #1: 'Concrescent desire is the lure or pressure by which something wants to become'
glyph_rationales.occasion: #1: 'Actual occasion is the concrete event in which that possibility is attempted'
glyph_rationales.ingression: #1: 'Ingression is the entry of possible form into actuality'
glyph_rationales.forms: #1: eternal objects — 'the available forms, patterns and determinations through which the occasion can take shape'
glyph_rationales.community: #1: 'Community integration asks whether the resulting form can enter the wider world'
glyph_rationales.satisfaction: #1: 'Satisfaction/Perishing names both completion and passage' — the occasion becomes inherited condition
glyph_rationales.Aether: #2: 'the open field of possibility in which the work can begin'
glyph_rationales.Fire: #2: 'transforms through energetic difference, conflict, testing and irreversible passage'
glyph_rationales.Salt: #2: 'precipitates the attained form: the result that can now persist, circulate and become material for another becoming'
glyph_rationales.Gate: #3: 'A Gate decides whether a candidate satisfies a declared condition'
glyph_rationales.Recognition: #3: 'Recognition asks what the encounter means for the conditions themselves' — it can revise the commission
glyph_rationales.candidate: #3: the artifact under judgment — 'A candidate becomes meaningful through the commission and sources from which it arose'
glyph_rationales.commission: #3/#4: the commission the candidate arose from; in #4 the first site of labour
glyph_rationales.implementation: #4: the site where labour implements — one of the gathered sites of entrusted power
glyph_rationales.review: #4: the review of the work — where dissent can form
glyph_rationales.use: #4: the use that bears the design
glyph_rationales.consequence: #4: 'If a user bears the consequence of a design while having no route by which that consequence can alter the design, development has become one-way inscription'
glyph_rationales.Project Canon: #5->0: the project's inherited ground — one form the changed field takes
glyph_rationales.returned Ground: #5->0: the return — 'The field does not circle back unchanged'
glyph_rationales.changed condition: #5->0: 'a new condition of further becoming' — the product of development
glyph_rationales.README: the bound material record's address stamp — the Factory README bound at movement #0
glyph_rationales.PRAXIS-PRIMITIVES: the bound record's address stamp — the praxis primitives bound at movement #1
glyph_rationales.QL-SOFTWARE-FACTORY-PRIMITIVE-RELATIONS: the bound record's address stamp — Primitive Relations and Experienced Ontology, the material-grammar seed bound at movement #2
glyph_rationales.RUN-CLOSURE-VERIFICATION-ALIGNMENT: the bound record's address stamp — the run closure/verification record bound at movement #3
glyph_rationales.FACTORY-SELF-HOSTING-COMMISSION: the bound record's address stamp — the self-hosting commission bound at movement #4
glyph_rationales.PROJECT-DEVELOPMENT-ORIENTATION-AND-RETU: the bound record's address stamp — the project development orientation-and-return record bound at movement #5->0
